source_verification_receipts.locator: Section 3, Algorithm 1 and Theorems 2–3; Section 7, pp. 2140–2141 / rendered lines 159–183 and 356–360
source_verification_receipts.verified_claim: The paper defines immediate-stop pair-switching PSRR, proves unbiasedness and a variance-reduction lower bound, and states that the nonuniform PSRR law makes asymptotic distributions of common statistics challenging and leaves that problem to future work.

The preprint derives stationary mass proportional to M(W)^(-1/T) for its pair-switching chain and then uses a rejection correction whose output is uniform on the acceptable set; it does not analyze original immediate first entry.
The article studies uniform Mahalanobis rerandomization and derives a non-Gaussian ATE limit consisting of Gaussian and truncated-Gaussian components under finite-population regularity.

The article develops randomization-based asymptotic distributions, regression adjustment, and variance estimation under rerandomization, with fixed covariate dimensions, and recommends fully interacted adjustment with robust variance.
The article develops Gaussian prepivoting for finite-population causal inference, retaining sharp-null exactness while obtaining weak-null asymptotic validity, including rerandomized designs.

The result is a weak-convergence diffusion limit for a fixed coordinate of random-walk Metropolis chains with symmetric product targets under high-dimensional scaling, rather than a finite-population stopped pair-exchange result.

strengthening_paths.suggestion: Repair the stopped-chain domain: prove eventual nonemptiness of the acceptable set from the initialization CLT, incorporate it into the deterministic tail, and formulate predictable characteristics strictly before entry.
Add Fiksel (2024) to related work and state a direct contrast between its Fisher-exact covariate-adjusted inversion and the proposed single-run heterogeneous-effect asymptotic interval.

Make the terminal-law route more discriminating by adding an explicit isotropic stopped-diffusion lemma showing why the entrance direction is uniform and why independent stationary E_H remains independent of D_H.

recommended_next_step: Revise the stopping-time/characteristic domain and broaden the interval-inference survey, then retain this field-tier first-entry PSRR angle for Stage 0.
